sources: recreation.gov public campsite search for facility 234472 (per-site catalog), read 2026-10-22

values.note: 'Open year-round. Not plowed in winter.' The concessionaire runs it in summer; recreation.gov sells sites mid-May to late September.

season.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r01/flathead/recreation/tally-lake-campground (Seasons of Use: 'Open year-round. Not plowed in winter.'; 'managed by a concessionaire, Flathead Valley Campgrounds, during the summer months') + recreation.gov /rates (Peak Season 2026-05-15 to 2026-09-25), read 2026-10-22

values.note: Single site $22 per night; group site $150; extra vehicle $5 per night (2 passenger vehicles per site, the first included). A double-occupancy site is charged per camper.

fees.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r01/flathead/recreation/tally-lake-campground ('Single Site: $22 per night', 'Group Site: $150 per night', 'Extra Vehicle Fee: $5 per night') + recreation.gov /rates (Peak Season 2026-2028 STANDARD NONELECTRIC 22) and notices, read 2026-10-22

values.note: 50% off standard site fees with an Interagency Senior or Access pass (or Golden Age/Access passport); no discount on group sites, dump fees or extra vehicles; the Interagency Annual pass gives none.

discounts.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r01/flathead/recreation/tally-lake-campground ('A 50% discount on all standard site fees and day use fees will be offered to holders of the Golden Age and Golden Access Passports, as well as holders of the Interagency Senior and Access Passes. Discounts will not be offered to holders of the Interagency Annual or Volunteer Pass.'), read 2026-10-22

values.note: 21 reservable sites and 17 first-come, first-served (walk-up) sites, plus a group site (39) and a group pavilion. Reservation holders may not move to a walk-up site. Reserved sites held until 11 a.m. the day after arrival. Group sites: 10-night limit.

booking.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/234472 ('38 rentable sites with 21 of them being reservable and 17 are for our walk-up visitors', 'The stay limit is 16 consecutive nights'; rule maxConsecutiveStay 16) + https://www.fs.usda.gov/r01/flathead/recreation/tally-lake-campground ('There are some sites that remain first come-first served'), read 2026-10-22

values.note: 38 single sites plus group site 39. The recreation.gov catalog gives lengths for only a few sites: 30-40 ft back-ins (sites 2, 3, 5, 6) and a 60-ft pull-through (site 4).

sites.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/234472 ('The campground offers 39 campsites for tent and RV camping') + recreation.gov per-site catalog (site 004 Max Vehicle Length 60, Pull-Through; 002 36, 005 40, 003/006 30, back-in), read 2026-10-22

values.note: Dump station with a water fill station; the spigots in the campground are for drinking-water jugs only, not for filling an RV.

facilities.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/234472 ('Accessible vault toilets and drinking water are provided. As well as a dump station with a water fill station. Water spigots throughout the campground are not for filling your RV') + FS page ('Vault toilet(s)', 'Potable water is available at this site.'), read 2026-10-22

note: Flathead NF (Tally Lake RD) campground on the north shore of Tally Lake, W of Whitefish, the last ~9 mi on a dirt road; run in summer by concessionaire Flathead Valley Campgrounds. Boat ramp, beaches, open-air pavilion and day-use area; dogs not allowed on the beach. --Claude
summary: Concessionaire-run in summer (Flathead Valley Campgrounds) on Forest Service land. Confirmed $22, reservable on rec.gov with 17 FCFS sites, 39 sites, vault toilets + water. Changed max_rig_ft 40 -> 60 (catalog site 4, pull-through). Added season (open year-round, not plowed in winter), 16-night max, dump station, 50% Senior/Access discount, $5 extra vehicle. Not clear: cutoff (rec.gov value 4 with no unit). No alerts for the campground or its road. Note trimmed.
